title: Austin 1991-92 Budget: Live Within Means
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened exclusively for the presentation of Austin's proposed 1991-92 City Budget by City Manager Camille Barnett.
*   The budget's central theme highlighted "Live Within Our Means," focusing on fiscal responsibility and efficient resource management.
*   Additional priorities within the proposed budget included a strong emphasis on improving customer service and investing in the city's workforce.
